headline.zh: 把一款商品，变成一支广告的创意
headline.en: Turn a product into an ad concept

scenario.zh: 你经营一家小型电商品牌。新品已有照片，但还没有预算请团队拍广告。试着为一款随行杯设计社交短片。
scenario.en: Your small shop has product photos but no budget for a film crew. Plan a social ad for a travel tumbler.

initial.zh: 轻量随行杯：通勤路上，单手也能轻松喝水
initial.en: A lightweight travel tumbler for easy, one-handed sipping on the commute

instruction.zh: 切换素材起点，查看创意简报的变化。
instruction.en: Switch the starting material to compare the prepared creative briefs.

output.zh: 以随行杯轮廓为视觉主角，先让观众看清商品。
output.en: Make the tumbler the visual focus so viewers recognize the product.

output.zh: 以随行杯轮廓为视觉主角，先让观众看清商品。
output.en: Make the tumbler the visual focus so viewers recognize the product.

output.zh: 从示例商品资料提炼通勤场景与单手使用卖点。此处不抓取真实链接。
output.en: Use the sample product brief to highlight commuting and one-handed use. No live URL is fetched.

output.zh: 从示例商品资料提炼通勤场景与单手使用卖点。此处不抓取真实链接。
output.en: Use the sample product brief to highlight commuting and one-handed use. No live URL is fetched.

instruction.zh: 同一款商品，可以拍出两种不同的购买理由。
instruction.en: The same product can tell two different stories.

output.zh: 从赶地铁时腾不开手的困扰切入，再展示随行杯如何融入通勤。
output.en: Open with the hassle of a busy commute, then show where the tumbler fits into daily life.

output.zh: 从赶地铁时腾不开手的困扰切入，再展示随行杯如何融入通勤。
output.en: Open with the hassle of a busy commute, then show where the tumbler fits into daily life.

output.zh: 以杯身细节与干净的构图突出设计，让观众先记住商品外观。
output.en: Use clean framing and product details to make the design memorable.

output.zh: 以杯身细节与干净的构图突出设计，让观众先记住商品外观。
output.en: Use clean framing and product details to make the design memorable.

title.zh: 看看广告如何安排镜头
title.en: See how a shot list tells the story

instruction.zh: 切换顺序，比较示例分镜。这里没有生成图像或视频。
instruction.en: Switch sequences to compare prepared shot lists. No images or video are generated here.

label.zh: 痛点 → 解决 → 行动

output.zh: 开头提出通勤困扰，中段说明卖点，结尾邀请了解商品。
output.en: Start with the commuting problem, explain the benefit, then invite viewers to learn more.

input.zh: 轻量随行杯：通勤路上，单手也能轻松喝水
input.en: A lightweight travel tumbler for easy, one-handed sipping on the commute

output.zh: 痛点 → 解决 → 行动

detail.zh: 一手提包，一手还需要拿水杯。
detail.en: One hand holds a bag; the other needs a drink.

detail.zh: 展示随行杯在通勤路上的使用场景。
detail.en: Show the tumbler in a commuting situation.

detail.zh: 留下商品名称与了解详情的入口。
detail.en: End with the product name and where to learn more.

label.zh: 细节 → 场景 → 行动

output.zh: 开头给出商品细节，中段进入日常场景，结尾留下品牌印象。
output.en: Lead with a product detail, place it in daily life, and end with a brand impression.

input.zh: 轻量随行杯：通勤路上，单手也能轻松喝水
input.en: A lightweight travel tumbler for easy, one-handed sipping on the commute

output.zh: 细节 → 场景 → 行动

detail.zh: 用干净构图介绍随行杯外观。
detail.en: Introduce the tumbler in a clean close-up.

detail.zh: 把商品放回通勤的日常情境。
detail.en: Place the product in an everyday commute.

detail.zh: 以商品名称与简短卖点收尾。
detail.en: Close with the name and a short product benefit.

instruction.zh: 确认目标渠道与商品卖点，再保存创意简报。真实视频需到 Higgsfield 生成。
instruction.en: Review the channel and product brief, then save the creative plan. Generate the actual video in Higgsfield.

output.zh: 方案强调开头的吸引力与清晰卖点，适合交给短视频广告制作流程。
output.en: The plan emphasizes a strong opening and clear benefit for a social ad production workflow.

takeaway.zh: Higgsfield 的价值是把商品素材、创意方向与视频制作放进同一个流程，降低小团队反复制作广告素材的门槛。你刚完成的是可带走的创意方案。
takeaway.en: Higgsfield brings product assets, creative direction and video production into one workflow. You have built a creative brief to take into production.
